about: Case items for the Episode Spec page, judged yes or no on top of the confidence bar. They come from Han's four feedback rounds on the page, which he approved on 2026-11-14. Each quote comes from calibration.md.

items.question: Do the Brief, Style, Visual language and Episode page appear as one row of collapsed cards ahead of the first item, so the first decision starts high on the page?

source.quote: sit in one row of collapsible cards, closed by default, ahead of the first item

items.question: Is the page's toolbar sticky and on a single row, with the render presets as one segmented bar whose labels are names only and whose sizes show in tooltips (for example "Laptop, 1440 px")?

source.quote: the render presets as one segmented bar with a single selection

items.question: Is the outline a dropdown on the toolbar rather than a list that takes page width?

source.quote: It holds the outline as a dropdown

items.question: Does each item have one pick bar with a segment per Option, a star on the recommended Option's segment, a last Redesign segment, and beside it a Show details toggle and Reset?

source.quote: a last segment, Redesign, which clears the pick

items.question: On first load, is the recommended Option selected in every item that has one, so a Slide the reader does not touch goes with the recommendation?

source.quote: the recommended Option is selected when the page loads

items.question: Does each item have a single comment field about four rows tall that is marked optional?

source.quote: each item has one comment field, optional, 4 rows by default

items.question: Do a Slide's Visual idea, Voice script and Speaker notes sit in the rail beside the mock, each as a collapsible that starts closed, so the mock leads the main column?

source.quote: one collapsible each, closed by default, so the mock leads the main column

items.question: Is the review panel (general comment, Next action, Before you approve, Save) at the bottom of the page and as wide as the content, with nothing empty beside it?

source.quote: at the bottom of the page and the full width of the content

items.question: Is there one small circle at the bottom right, split into a to-top half and a to-bottom half that each show only a caret and no text?

source.quote: one small circle at the bottom right, split into a to-top and a to-bottom half, each showing only a caret

items.question: With the shorts preset selected, is each mock a 9:16 frame scaled down so that all of it is visible below the toolbar without scrolling?

source.quote: scaled down to fit the viewport below the toolbar, so the whole 9:16 frame is visible without scrolling

items.question: Is a Copy as prompt button present in the review panel next to Save?

source.quote: always present, in the review panel next to Save

items.question: Does the page look minimalist and modern, with quiet borders and shadows, consistent radii and a restrained accent, rather than dense or heavy chrome?

source.quote: minimalist and modern, with quiet borders and shadows, consistent radii and a restrained accent
